main.content:
== Portals ==

Portals serve as thematic entry points to BITwiki, organizing content around major knowledge domains. Unlike traditional wikis that may have overlapping organizational systems, BITwiki uses portals to create clear, focused pathways to related content.

=== Portal Structure ===

Each portal follows a standardized structure:
'' Main portal page - Overview and navigation hub
'' Subpages - Detailed topic areas within the portal
'' Navigation boxes - Links to key articles and categories
'' Related portals - Connections to other relevant knowledge domains

=== Portal Organization ===

BITwiki portals are organized around four primary domains:
= Ideas - Theoretical concepts and foundational knowledge =
= Implementations - Actual projects and practical applications =
= Domains - Knowledge areas like Biology, Technology, etc. =
= Site - Governance, policies, and community information =

=== Portal Creation Guidelines ===

When creating new portals, follow these guidelines:
'' Use clear, descriptive names that reflect the portal's focus
'' Include an introductory paragraph explaining the portal's scope
'' Provide links to key articles and categories within the domain
'' Cross-reference related portals to create knowledge connections
'' Maintain consistent formatting with other portals

=== Portal Maintenance ===

Portals require regular maintenance to remain useful:
'' Update links when content is moved or renamed
'' Add new relevant content as it's created
'' Remove outdated or broken links
* Review portal organization periodically for clarity

This portal system enables users to navigate BITwiki's knowledge base efficiently while maintaining the semantic relationships between ideas and implementations.
